gaps: a SpatialSound plays only while it is drawn in X_ITE (its traversed flag, which a Switch or culling turns off); the bridge plays it whenever it is enabled
spatialize is an initializeOnly field: set at load, bypassing the panner; the routing is not read back
dopplerEnabled and priority are held; Web Audio has no doppler and there is one voice per node
a maxDistance of 0 or less is refused by Web Audio (RangeError): the old distance stays; X_ITE 16.6.0 raises the error inside its event handler, so the test does not try it
